comment: Hand-authored, and the only geographic or editorial fact written by hand.
Everything else in scene-sites.json is derived: see
Give a scene an entry only when the derived value is wrong or missing: a
title a person would recognise, a summary worth writing out, or a position
for a recording the archive index does not cover. A position here wins over
the one the archive site carries, so a survey is never overwritten by a
reading taken off the paper field map.

broadway-telegraph-hill.title: Broadway & Columbus
broadway-telegraph-hill.summary: A North Beach junction, recorded from a static roadside sensor.
broadway-telegraph-hill.position_note: Hand-entered to the junction, not surveyed. The field mark for this site reads 'Broadway below Telegraph Hill, near Sansome', which is about 600 m from where the sensor actually stood; the junction name is the better fix and overrides it. Correcting the mark would rename this scene.
